description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the “Activated Parameters Ratio (%)” on the x-axis and the “Eval PPL” (Evaluation Perplexity) on the y-axis for four different model configurations: “Transformer” (dashed red line), “Only MoHD FFN” (gray square markers with solid line), “Only MoHD ATTN” (dark blue circle markers with solid line), and “MoHD ATTN + MLP” (cyan star markers with solid line). The x-axis is linear, ranging from 100% to 25% in decrements of 25, labeled as “Activated Parameters Ratio (%)”. The y-axis is linear, ranging from 11.5 to 14.0 in increments of 0.5, labeled as “Eval PPL”. The “Transformer” baseline remains nearly flat across all ratios, starting at approximately 11.6 at 100% and ending at 11.7 at 25%. “Only MoHD FFN” begins at 11.6 at 100%, dips slightly to 11.5 at 75%, then rises to 11.7 at 50%, and ends at 11.8 at 25%. “Only MoHD ATTN” starts at 11.6 at 100%, increases gradually to 12.0 at 50%, then sharply rises to 14.0 at 25%. “MoHD ATTN + MLP” begins at 11.6 at 100%, rises to 12.0 at 50%, and reaches 13.1 at 25%. All lines show increasing perplexity as the activated parameter ratio decreases, with “Only MoHD ATTN” exhibiting the steepest degradation at lower ratios.
